change: Version 0.1: first release with 13 cases, 34 official responses and 34 policy instruments across ASEAN, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam and the Philippines. Every row has a source link and a confidence rating.
Method decision: any action by a government body or a person with official authority counts as a response (statements, warnings, advisories, investigations, orders, laws).

Version 0.2: added Thailand; 6 new cases (SG-I-05, TH-I-01 to TH-I-03, PH-I-03, PH-I-04), 8 new official responses and 9 new policies (6 Thailand, 1 Philippines, 2 ASEAN including DEFA, signed 14 Nov 2026). Added an aim_url column linking cases to their OECD AI Incidents and Hazards Monitor record. Added coverage and proof-of-concept notices.

Version 0.3: optional cookieless visitor counting with GoatCounter (off by default, nothing is added to the page unless a site code is set). New Visitors tab with a live total, a region view, a country table, referring sites, tab use and downloads, shown only after 30 visits and with groups under 3 merged. New fetch_stats.py and a daily GitHub workflow refresh the country snapshot. No cookies; nothing is counted for Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control or local files.

Weekly update (brought forward from 25 Nov): watch list cleared — SG-P-08 and SG-P-10 now in force; ID-P-05 and MY-P-05 still pending with corrected milestones; PH-P-07 lapsed with the 19th Congress. 21 new incidents, 20 new responses, 17 new instruments; first incidents on election-integrity, data-protection and online-safety themes. Backlog 22 → 15 items.
